title: Print LaTeX Technology
description: Add independent print technology: expl3 LaTeX framework with Tectonic, semio design tokens, report/paper/flyer templates, and Zukunft Bau report family.
summary: Added independent print technology: expl3 LaTeX framework (semio.cls + modular .sty packages) with Tectonic prebuilt binary bootstrap, token/font generation from ui/styling/tokens.json, report/paper/flyer templates, and Zukunft Bau report family. All 6 template PDFs build via bun ./script.ts test.
